abstract: Run and tune Kokoro-FastAPI, the Dockerized OpenAI-compatible server for the Kokoro-82M text-to-speech model. References cover image tags per hardware, every environment variable with defaults, the verified HTTP routes (voices, blends, inline tags, SSML, captions, phonemes), performance and VRAM reclaim, LiteLLM, llama-swap and Open WebUI integration, updating and troubleshooting, with templates and a curl script.
